description: Fix the four PR 1086 review findings on history fragments
acceptance_criteria: Every valid change id round-trips through its fragment; a fragment swapped for a same-bytes symlink is re-validated instead of replaying a cached pass; a delta item that targets the Change Log is refused at approve, check, verify and accept; a reformatted legacy row plus a fragment is refused as a double record and a row for one-session does not count for session

answers.constraints: REQ-change-159 and REQ-change-160 (#1084), REQ-hash-cache-006, and the #741 lesson that the record of a change in a module is the evidence that materialization ran
